title: Draw Through
shortDescription: 100 complete drawing lessons, offline references and your own practice studio.
fullDescription:
Learn to look. Make your mark.

Draw Through is a drawing field school and reference studio with 100 complete workshops, 100 unique offline references and a practice that becomes your own.

FOLLOW THE DRAWING PATH
Explore 12 chapters: confident line, observation, form, botanical studies, still life, nature, landscape, perspective, people, animals and your own artistic voice. Every lesson includes an explanation, reference observation, setup, detailed demonstration, three exercises, troubleshooting, an independent assignment and a way to practice away from the screen. Search by skill, filter chapters and save lessons for later.

MAKE YOUR OWN MARKS
Draw with a finger or stylus. Start with Guide, fade the reference and try Freehand. Use Pencil, Ink, a stroke eraser, undo and redo. Add a grid, work in monochrome or import your own reference photo. Save a reflection and complete a study when you are ready. Your drawings and notes stay in My practice, ready to revisit and share.

LOOK CLOSER
Browse 100 original AI-created reference images, with a different image for every lesson. Filter by subject, pinch to zoom, try monochrome and use an observation grid. Open the related workshop or take a reference into the light table. The images depict imagined subjects; use life and your own photos to check anatomy and physical detail.

YOUR REFERENCE STUDIO
Arrange personal photos and course references in layers. Drag, resize and rotate, adjust opacity and contrast, switch to black and white or outlines, and choose a background. Lock the composition for tracing on paper and hold to unlock. Save, duplicate, favorite, export or share your compositions.

OFFLINE AND PERSONAL
All lessons and course images are included. No account, advertisements, subscription, in-app purchases or resource downloads. Drawings, reflections, progress and imported images are stored on your device. You choose when to export or share.

Completion records your own reflection on an exercise, not automatic skill assessment. Practice a little. Notice more. Make it your own.
releaseNotes: Draw Through comes to Android with all 100 lessons, 100 offline references, a drawing practice pad, personal study journal and layered light table.
dataSafety: No app data collected or shared by the developer. User-directed image exports and Android sharing are optional. No account, analytics, advertising or billing.
reviewAccess: All content is available without sign-in or payment. Complete the three introduction pages, open a lesson in Learn, then Open practice pad. Draw before using Complete study. References opens the full offline gallery; Arrange in the light table creates a composition. Studio supports personal photo imports and transformations. Trace mode unlocks with a two-second hold.
